dataList.content:
You all heard that too... right?
大家……听到了吧？
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Corridors
呼啸山庄 走廊

dataList.content:
That noise every time we killed one of them. That noise from beyond their masks...
每当他们断气时会有声音……隔着面具传来……

... The sound of mirrors.
镜子的声音……

They made a sound not unlike a shattering mirror.
那像是镜子碎裂的声音。

Ishmael approached the Dead Rabbits henchman's corpse and unmasked him.
以实玛利扒开了死兔帮成员尸体上的面具。

... We should unmask the rest of them to get a better picture of what is happening here.
……把其他人的面具也都摘下看看，估计会更清楚。

Things became even more puzzling once they were all unmasked.
将他们的面具各自摘下之后……违和感变得愈发强烈。

I don't want to judge a book by its cover, but...
虽然我觉得以貌取人并不好……

... Hardly do they appear to be members of a violent Backstreets Syndicate.
……这些人……看起来实在不像后巷的暴力帮派成员。

I can tell from their build that none of them were ever part of a Syndicate. They look more like… civilians.
就算单看肌肉的状态，比起帮派成员而言……他们更像是普通人。

But... they attacked us first, right? We were just…
是他们……先攻击我们的。我们只是……

Eyes up. More Dead Rabbits... Red eyes, all of them.
对面。又有死兔帮的人……走过来了。依旧是眼睛闪着红光。

Hark! Heed mine words! Whatever is thy—
喂，清醒点！说说发生了何事……！

死兔帮
dataList.teller:

诡异的死兔帮成员

dataList.content:
I don't think this is the best time to attempt the diplomatic approach...
看来现在管不了谁先谁后了……
